Two agencies on one Meta ad account. "At most 4 changes a day" becomes 8.

It happens when a brand moves agency and the old one keeps access for a few weeks, or when prospecting and retargeting sit with different agencies in the same account.

Each limit only counts its own changes, so neither agency sees the other's 4. Two sets of guardrails on one account aren't two safeguards.

Adspenta's rule is the boring one: if the same Meta ad account is connected in two agencies, neither can make live changes until one lets go.

Before you set any rule on a new client's account, ask who else still has access to it. AI voice.
